text: あせ　かいて　すこし　やせた　きが　するぜえ

patterns.name: 〜気がする
patterns.span: やせた　きが　する
patterns.explanation: きがする after a short statement says 'I get the feeling that...'. やせた　きが　する = 'I feel like I slimmed down'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins one action to the next, and here also hints at the reason. あせ　かいて = 'I sweated, and so...'.
